items.title_zh: “我永远不卖”：我 47 岁，把挣到的每一块钱都用来买比特币，我疯了吗？
items.summary: “When my paycheck lands, it takes a detour through bitcoin.”
items.summary_zh: “工资一到账，就先绕道比特币。”

items.title: Landscape Architecture moves into storage, planning to acquire 93.5% of Hualan Micro
items.title_zh: 园林股份“跨界”存储 拟收购华澜微93.5%股份
items.summary: After a 10-session trading halt, the major asset restructuring plan for Landscape Architecture is out.
items.summary_zh: 停牌10个交易日后， 园林股份 重大资产重组方案出炉

items.title: The AI boom drives strong cash flow as Nvidia announces an additional $150 billion share buyback
items.title_zh: AI热潮带来强劲现金流 英伟达宣布追加1500亿美元股票回购
items.summary: As the artificial intelligence boom continues to drive revenue and cash flow growth, Nvidia announced a substantial expansion of its share buyback plan, marking an acceleration in capital returns by the world's most valuable listed company.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能 （AI）热潮持续推动收入和现金流增长之际， 英伟达 宣布大幅扩大股票回购计划，标志着这家全球市值最高的上市公司正加快向股东返还资本

items.title: Shell backs $23 billion LNG Canada expansion in boost to Carney's ‘energy superpower’ push
items.title_zh: 壳牌支持 230 亿美元加拿大 LNG 扩建项目，助力卡尼的“能源超级大国”计划
items.summary: The investment puts Canada on course to become a leading LNG exporter as global supply disruptions sharpen focus on energy security.
items.summary_zh: 该投资将使加拿大有望成为领先的 LNG 出口国，因为全球供应中断令能源安全更受关注。

items.title: SpaceX is poised for a big comeback after recent struggles, says TD Cowen
items.title_zh: TD Cowen 称 SpaceX 在近期困境后有望强劲反弹
items.summary: Investors should scoop up shares of SpaceX as growth in the artificial intelligence and space industries will drive gains, according to TD Cowen.
items.summary_zh: TD Cowen 认为投资者应买入 SpaceX 股票，因为人工智能与航天产业的增长将推动其上涨。

items.title: Zuckerberg, Amodei among tech executives set to meet Trump Tuesday
items.title_zh: 扎克伯格、Amodei 等科技高管将于周二会见特朗普
items.summary: The AI safety debate has raged in recent weeks, with Amodei, Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman calling to pace the development of frontier models.
items.summary_zh: 近几周 AI 安全争论持续升温，Amodei、马斯克与 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 均呼吁放慢前沿模型的开发节奏。

items.title: Smart ring maker Oura postpones IPO due to market 'uncertainty'
items.title_zh: 智能戒指厂商 Oura 因市场“不确定性”推迟 IPO
items.summary: Oura said the delay comes despite "strong demand" and a strengthenthing of the business since the start of the IPO process.
items.summary_zh: Oura 表示，尽管需求强劲、且自 IPO 流程启动以来业务有所增强，公司仍决定推迟上市。

items.title: GAC and FAW tie the knot through a share swap as central-local automaker restructuring begins
items.title_zh: 广汽一汽“换股联姻”，央地车企重组大幕拉开
items.summary: Consolidation of state-owned automakers has been discussed for years; this time it has finally reached assets.
items.summary_zh: 国有车企的整合谈了很多年，这一次，终于动到了资产

items.title: A first in central fiscal history: the mortgage interest subsidy lands before the holiday, covering first homes under 120 square metres and under 1.5 million yuan
items.title_zh: 中央财政史上首次！“房贷贴息”节前落地：首套、120平方米以下、150万元以内可享
items.summary: The Ministry of Finance, the People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly published a notice on Sept 29 confirming that a residential home-purchase loan interest subsidy policy takes effect from Oct 1, 2026, provisionally for one year.
items.summary_zh: 财政部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局9月29日联合对外发布通知，明确自2026年10月1日起，实施居民购房贷款贴息政策，政策实施期暂定1年

items.title: Trump’s municipal bond portfolio reaches as much as $1 billion as policy overlaps mount
items.title_zh: 特朗普的市政债券持仓最高达 10 亿美元，政策重叠问题日益突出
items.summary: President Donald Trump disclosed municipal bond holdings worth $300 million to $1 billion, including debt tied to issuers affected by federal policy.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统特朗普披露持有 3 亿至 10 亿美元的市政债券，其中包括与受联邦政策影响的发行人相关的债务。

items.title: From Oct 1 China will apply a 1 percentage point annualised interest subsidy to residential home-purchase loans
items.title_zh: 10月1日起我国将对居民购房实施年化1个百分点贷款贴息
items.summary: The reporter learned from the Ministry of Finance today (the 29th) that China will apply an interest subsidy from Oct 1 to residents buying homes with newly issued commercial personal housing loans, in order to lower purchase costs and better support and release rigid housing demand among urban and rural residents.
items.summary_zh: 记者今天（29日）从财政部了解到，我国将从10月1日起对居民使用新发放商业性个人住房贷款购房实施贴息，以降低居民购房成本，更好支持和释放城乡居民刚性住房需求

items.title: PBoC: cuts the pledged supplementary lending rate by 0.25 percentage points and brings six-network construction into the PSL support scope
items.title_zh: 中国央行：下调抵押补充贷款利率0.25个百分点，将“六张网”建设纳入抵押补充贷款支持领域
items.summary: To implement the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and the State Council executive meeting, and to carry out a moderately loose monetary policy, the People's Bank of China has decided to further adjust and refine several monetary policy tools on the basis of giving full play to the effectiveness of existing policies, in order to create an appropriate monetary and financial environment for steady economic growth, high-quality development and stable operation of financial markets, and to support a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.
items.summary_zh: 为贯彻中央政治局会议精神和国务院常务会议部署，实施好适度宽松的货币政策，中国人民银行在充分发挥各项存量政策效能的基础上，决定进一步调整完善几项货币政策工具，为经济平稳增长、高质量发展和金融市场稳定运行创造适宜的货币金融环境，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展，支持“十五五”实现良好开局

items.title: PBoC adjusts and refines several monetary policy tools: cuts the pledged supplementary lending (PSL) rate by 0.25 percentage points
items.title_zh: 央行调整完善若干货币政策工具：下调抵押补充贷款（PSL）利率0.25个百分点
items.summary: To implement the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and the State Council executive meeting, and to carry out a moderately accommodative monetary policy, the People's Bank of China has decided to further adjust and refine several monetary policy tools on the basis of giving full play to the effectiveness of existing policies, in order to create an appropriate monetary and financial environment for steady economic growth, high-quality development and stable operation of financial markets, and to support a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.
items.summary_zh: 为贯彻中央政治局会议精神和国务院常务会议部署，实施好适度宽松的货币政策，中国人民 银行 在充分发挥各项存量政策效能的基础上，决定进一步调整完善几项货币政策工具，为经济平稳增长、高质量发展和金融市场稳定运行创造适宜的货币金融环境，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展，支持“十五五”实现良好开局

items.title: Muse demand reaches CPUs as lead times stretch to 25-30 weeks
items.title_zh: Muse需求传导至CPU，CPU交货期拉长至25-30周
items.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse is pushing the CPU from a supporting role in the AI narrative to centre stage: the latest TrendForce report shows CPU lead times have stretched to 25-30 weeks from the usual 16-20 weeks, which it attributes directly to demand from AI agents such as Muse.
items.summary_zh: Meta的人工智能代理Muse正在把CPU从AI叙事的配角推向舞台中央——TrendForce最新报告显示， CPU交货周期已从通常的16-20周拉长至25-30周，并将这一变化直接归因于Muse等AI代理对CPU需求的拉动

items.title: OpenAI to reopen its $200 plan, but Tibo is taking heavy criticism
items.title_zh: OpenAI将重新开放200美元套餐，但Tibo被骂惨了
items.summary: Just now, the reset god Tibo tweeted again — but this time it is not a reset.
items.summary_zh: 刚刚，重置之神 Tibo 又发推了，但这次不是重置

items.title: Meta launches Muse for Small Business as Zuckerberg pushes beyond consumer AI market
items.title_zh: Meta 面向小企业推出 Muse，扎克伯格推动业务超越消费级 AI 市场
items.summary: Following the success of its Muse personal AI agent, Meta is introducing a specialized version for small businesses.
items.summary_zh: 继个人 AI 智能体 Muse 取得成功后，Meta 正在推出一款面向小企业的专用版本。

items.title: Lisa Su lands Fei-Fei Li for 55 billion yuan: two Chinese-American leaders join forces to seize the next AI generation
items.title_zh: 苏姿丰550亿拿下李飞飞：两大华人女王合体，抢下一代AI
items.summary: Another epic acquisition has just detonated in AI circles: two Silicon Valley Chinese-American leaders have formally joined forces. AMD's Lisa Su will take World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth about $8.2 billion, equivalent to roughly 55 billion yuan. Once the deal closes, Fei-Fei Li will join AMD directly as executive vice president and chief scientist, reporting to Lisa Su.
items.summary_zh: 刚刚，AI圈又炸出一笔史诗级收购！两位硅谷华人女王，正式合体！ AMD苏姿丰要用约82亿美元、折合人民币约550亿元，全股票拿下李飞飞创办的World Labs！ 交易完成后，李飞飞将直接加入AMD，担任执行副总裁兼首席科学家，向苏姿丰汇报
